sdt-cases.alt: Three panels with a flat tangent line at x = c where f'(c) = 0. Left: concave up, f''(c) > 0, a relative minimum. Middle: concave down, f''(c) < 0, a relative maximum. Right: f''(c) = 0, and x to the fourth (a minimum), negative x to the fourth (a maximum) and x cubed (neither) show that the test says nothing.
